correctness.rationale: Every homomorphism has a unique A,B block form, and P^2=P iff A^2=A and BA+(wedge^2 A)B=B. Image/kernel decomposition makes the B-solution space have the exact stated dimension. The Gaussian-binomial complement count gives the full rank formula and a central-shear conjugation establishes one orbit for each rank. The exact cubic exponent has a unique positive maximum with distance at least sqrt(7)n/2-O(1) in exponent from all ranks outside the two adjacent integers; the Gaussian correction is uniformly bounded by an Euler product. This proves the exponentially accurate tail. The direct verifier exhausts n=2 over F2,F3 and n=3 over F2 and independently composes candidate operators and computes ranks. Boundary r=0,n and characteristic two need no exceptions. Finite checks are not used as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: Idempotent Lie endomorphisms classify retractions, a natural structural invariant. The exact count resolves every possible retraction image rank and conjugacy class in all free class-two Lie algebras over finite fields. The nontrivial central-map exponent moves the typical induced rank to (1+sqrt(7))/6 of n, sharply away from the linear-projection midpoint, and yields exponential two-point concentration and a cubic-growth exponent. This is an infinite-family structural and asymptotic law, not a routine finite table.
